purpose: Refine road or area recovery priorities with complete uploaded repair cost or duration.

execution_tiers.name: Gain per cost or duration
requires: complete positive repair cost or complete positive repair duration

execution_tiers.name: Feasible multi-crew schedule
execution_tiers.claim: Reserved until a solver-backed scheduling adapter and validation exist

primary_sources.citation: Nurre et al. (2012), Restoring infrastructure systems
Maya Duque, P.A., Dolinskaya, I.S. and Sørensen, K. (2016). Network repair crew scheduling and routing for emergency relief distribution problem.
Faturechi and Miller-Hooks (2014), Travel time resilience of roadway networks under disaster. Transportation Research Part B, 70, 47-64.

known_limitations: Missing or non-positive resource values force a transparent fallback to service gain.
A resource-normalised priority is not a crew-feasible or globally optimal schedule.
Area priorities are screening packages, not administrative or construction contracts.
